section_summary.extract_value: This is an introduction and literature review section for a study examining body appreciation and ethnic identity in Black college women. The section discusses the importance of positive body image constructs, racial/ethnic differences in body dissatisfaction and eating disorders, and the role of ethnic identity as a protective factor. The current study uses the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) to examine these constructs in Black college women, a population that has been underrepresented in prior body image research.
